facts.question: What is Usain Bolt's 100m world record time in seconds?
facts.statement: Usain Bolt's 100m world record is 9.58 seconds.
facts.explanation: Bolt set 9.58s at the 2009 World Championships in Berlin.

facts.question: How many Olympic gold medals did Usain Bolt win?
facts.statement: Usain Bolt won 8 Olympic gold medals.
facts.explanation: Bolt won eight golds across the 2008, 2012 and 2016 Games.

facts.question: How many Olympic gold medals did Carl Lewis win?
facts.statement: Carl Lewis won 9 Olympic gold medals.
facts.explanation: Lewis won nine golds across four Olympic Games.

facts.question: How many kilometres long is a marathon?
facts.explanation: The distance was fixed at 26 miles 385 yards after the 1908 London Olympics.

facts.question: What is Usain Bolt's 200m world record time in seconds?
facts.statement: Usain Bolt's 200m world record is 19.19 seconds.
facts.explanation: Bolt set it at the 2009 World Championships in Berlin, days after his 9.58 in the 100m.

facts.question: What is the women's 100m world record time in seconds?
facts.statement: Florence Griffith-Joyner's women's 100m world record is 10.49 seconds.
facts.explanation: Set at the 1988 US Olympic Trials, it has stood longer than any other sprint record.

facts.question: How many events make up the men's decathlon?
facts.statement: The men's decathlon is made up of 10 events.
facts.explanation: Ten events across two days, from the 100m to the 1500m, decide the score.

facts.question: How many laps of a standard outdoor track is the 1500m?
facts.statement: The 1500m is 3.75 laps of a standard 400m outdoor track.
facts.explanation: Because the race starts on the back straight it is often called the metric mile.
